# Hello World in Many Languages

> A static site comparing how different programming languages write "Hello, World!" and other
> basic constructs, built as an exercise in AI-assisted, spec-driven development with Spec Kit.

## Pages

- [Home](https://helloworld.valdir.dev.br/en): Compare Hello World, conditionals, loops, functions,
  and more across Java, Python, Dart, ABAP, and PHP.
- [About](https://helloworld.valdir.dev.br/en/about): Who built this project, and why.
- [History](https://helloworld.valdir.dev.br/en/history): The origin of "Hello, World!" as a
  programming tradition.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ValdirGiorgi/helloworld): Source code and the
  contribution guide for adding a new language.
